data.rationale: The proposal matches the true procedure (open hotels, type and pick destination, choose dates, set rooms/guests, search, then filter and sort), with the right parameters and order. It over-specifies children, child age, hotel class and the other filters, and it hard-codes sort to price low to high when the true sort and filters vary. It is concrete enough to automate, but a few parameters are missing or too narrow, such as a generic sort option.
